preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of each string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each character in the string s must be a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of erased symbols required to make the string a palindrome, or -1 if it is impossible.
